## sonarcloud-skill v0.1.1

- No user-visible changes in this release.
- No file changes detected from the previous version.

Initial release of sonarcloud-skill for managing SonarCloud and SonarQube findings.

- Enables inspection, triage, and management of Sonar findings across repositories.
- Reads authentication tokens securely from environment variables.
- Can auto-detect project settings via sonar-project.properties or receive them explicitly.
- Provides commands for issue, hotspot, quality gate, and project configuration management.
- Supports both SonarCloud and SonarQube API workflows with fallback to raw API calls.
- Includes extensive usage examples and security guidelines for handling tokens and outputs.
